node.title: Re: Do not understand code
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
unlink $file if /.BGV/; ... what does this 'if' means? What condition is it?

The if after a statement is a [doc://perlsyn#Statement-Modifiers|statement modifier], it is the equivalent of if (/.BGV/) { unlink $file }. The condition is equivalent to $_ =~ /.BGV/, that is, match the special variable [doc://$_] against the [doc://perlretut|regex] /.BGV/. The special variable [doc://$_] gets set in several places, one very common one is the while (<$filehandle>) { ... } loop, see [doc://perlop#I/O-Operators]. That line of code in English: If the string stored in $_ contains the four-character sequence of any character (except newline) followed by the string 'BGV', then [doc://unlink] (delete) the file whose name is given in the string $file.
